collection.title: BMW M3 2008 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A 2008 to 2013 version of a BMW M3 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the wiper blade to the arm.
